MUSKETEER SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000342]{Dual Martialism} 【Max SL 5】

As part of any Accuracy Check, or when invoked by Perfect Guard, spend 5 MP to swap the ranges of your equipped one-handed weapons (melee become thrown ranged, ranged become brawling melee); this ends on a weapon after its first use resolves. Once per round after you deal ranged damage, your next melee attack deals +(SL) damage, and vice versa.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000343]{Fluid Motion}

When you make a melee attack with multi (2) or higher, spend 5 MP to designate up to half those hits (rounded up) to use an equipped ranged weapon instead, and vice versa, keeping the original weapon's accuracy formula.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000344]{Riposte} 【Max SL 5】

Once per round when you or an ally is hit by an enemy attack, spend 10 MP to parry with a weapon whose range is opposite the attack's; the attack becomes an Opposed Check using the enemy's roll versus your weapon's accuracy formula. On success, choose: the attack deals (SL x 3) less damage before Affinities, or the enemy suffers slow (ignoring immunities). On a critical, choose both.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000345]{Perfect Guard} 【Max SL 4】

When targeted by an attack, gain +(1 + half SL) Defense (not stacking with shields or armor) as long as you have an equipped weapon whose range is opposite the attack's; this can be modified via Dual Martialism, treated as a check, by paying its MP.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000346]{Weave} 【Max SL 4】

When you successfully activate Riposte with a melee weapon, your next ranged weapon attack gains +(SL) Accuracy, and vice versa when you activate Riposte with a ranged weapon.
